sources.note: Re-opened. Published 17 Sept 2026 (updated 12 Oct). Crédoc for DGE; 9 655 firms, 23 March to 18 April 2026; 40 % use AI, +14 pts, x3 in two years; PME 34 % to 53 %; content generation 34 %, chatbots 24 %; 68 % of users see a positive impact; 19 % use paid solutions. Supports the new intro clause « En France, l'usage progresse vite ». All figures match.

Re-opened. 14 Oct 2026. Around 12 826 phone interviews, heads of SMEs and mid-caps with 1 to 749 employees, March-April 2026; 42 % already use AI and AM, mostly limited and experimental; 21 % plan to; customer service 47 %; barriers 50 / 49 / 48 %; 49 % do not trust AI for staff decisions; 90 % say people take the decisions. Supports the new intro clause « en Europe, il reste souvent expérimental » and the draft's « l'IA et le management algorithmique ». All figures match.

Re-opened. 13 Oct 2026. 1,416 U.S. enterprise leaders and entry-/mid-level employees; 80 % positive ROI, « only 28 % » strongly positive; growth-measured firms 35 % vs efficiency alone 13 %; 67 % use agents, 17 % let agents act autonomously; training 78 % leaders vs 56 % employees. Supports the new intro clause on rare strong returns and the reworded decision 1 (35 % vs 13 %, compared with efficiency-only firms). All figures match.
